audit_gates: 100+ trades, >70% net wins for goal; positive net/double-slip, PF1.3, DD<=10000, coverage99%, >=60% positive months, no daily overshoot, positive lower95 mean expectancy and paired daily improvement versus unscored same-scope policy
calibration: six preceding complete calendar months, positive-slope Platt; chronological day purges; min100 fit/40 calibration rows; same regularised estimators as decision-day study
consensus: equal average when at least two positively calibrated models available; no fitted ensemble weights
hypothesis: Pooling first CE/PE opportunities and six-month calibration reduces sparse-specialist instability; cross-model consensus may reduce estimator-specific noise
labels: unchanged frozen ATR-exit net wins; no new data or exit selection
learning_unit: first risk-eligible observation per day per direction, then remove unknown fit/cal labels; equal total day weight; at most two fitting rows/day, not assumed independent
selection: 12 fixed learner/scope profiles, nine cutoffs .40-.80 step .05; >70% target track, separately labelled >=60% partial economic track; same risk/profit/stability/neighbour support gates as decision-day study
trading: at most one accepted trade/day; each side contributes only its first predetermined opportunity; no later same-side retries after a low score
